scope: Korean citizen educated in Ontario; international first-year applicants, not Canadian-citizen-only rules. Candidate research, not admissions guarantees.
method: A published U.S. GPA minimum is not an Ontario percentage cutoff. No school below may be marked eligible from a single Ontario average unless the published school-specific assessment is actually satisfied. SAT totals do not replace an academic minimum unless explicitly stated.

academic.text: The international freshman minimum for most Arts, Social Sciences and Education majors is cumulative U.S.-equivalent GPA 2.0. Criminal Justice/Paralegal Studies require 2.5, education 2.7, business 2.8, and engineering science 3.0 plus a math benchmark.
academic.textKo: 국제 신입생 기준에서 예술·사회과학·교육대학의 일반 전공은 누적 환산 GPA 2.0입니다. 형사사법·법률보조 2.5, 교원양성 2.7, 경영 2.8, 공학 3.0 및 수학 기준보다 공개 기준이 낮습니다.

testing.text: History has no SAT minimum in the international program requirements. SAT Reading/Writing 510 is one English-proficiency option, not an academic GPA replacement.
testing.textKo: 역사학 국제 입학 기준에는 SAT 최저점이 없습니다. Reading/Writing 510은 영어 능력 증명 방법 중 하나이며 내신 요건을 대체하지 않습니다.

entry.unit: Judith Herb College of Arts, Social Sciences and Education
entry.text: History belongs to the college whose general international entry minimum is GPA 2.0. This verifies a lower published threshold than the listed professional majors, not a higher acceptance probability. The current sociology department lists Sociology as a minor, so do not recommend a Sociology B.A.
entry.textKo: 역사학은 국제 신입생 일반 기준 GPA 2.0을 적용하는 대학 소속입니다. 위 전문 전공보다 낮은 공개 기준은 확인되지만 합격률 우위는 확인되지 않았습니다. 현재 사회학은 부전공으로 기재되어 있어 사회학 B.A.로 안내하지 않습니다.

reviews.scenarioUse: Candidate to investigate, not confirmed eligible from Ontario average + SAT.

reviews.name: Washington State University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: International direct entry requires GPA 2.70. Students with GPA 2.30–2.69 can apply to the university’s Undergraduate Foundation program; WSU evaluates foreign grades. No Ontario percentage threshold is verified.
reviews.scenarioUse: Candidate to investigate, not confirmed eligible from Ontario average + SAT.
reviews.program: Sociology, B.A. / Undergraduate Foundation social-sciences track

reviews.name: Marshall University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: Minimum international high-school GPA 2.0, converted by Marshall; SAT/ACT required only for some majors.
reviews.scenarioUse: Review only; cannot map Ontario60–75% to this GPA without university assessment. Do not use SAT as a grade replacement.

reviews.name: University of Central Missouri
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: International high-school GPA minimum 2.0. No Ontario percentage conversion verified.
reviews.scenarioUse: Review only; cannot map Ontario60–75% to this GPA without university assessment. Do not use SAT as a grade replacement.

reviews.name: Murray State University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: International bachelor checklist requires high-school GPA 2.0; the general freshman page specifies holistic review for GPA 2.0–2.74. Do not describe 2.0 as assured admission.
reviews.scenarioUse: Review only; cannot map Ontario60–75% to this GPA without university assessment. Do not use SAT as a grade replacement.

reviews.name: Fort Hays State University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: International first-year GPA minimum 2.5. SAT/ACT not required per international FAQ.
reviews.scenarioUse: Review only; cannot map Ontario60–75% to this GPA without university assessment. Do not use SAT as a grade replacement.

reviews.name: Arkansas State University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: International freshman page says GPA 2.3 but current BA History page lists 3.0. Could be a generic domestic-page rule, but unresolved; do not claim international History admission at GPA2.3 without clarification.
reviews.scenarioUse: Review only; cannot map Ontario60–75% to this GPA without university assessment. Do not use SAT as a grade replacement.

reviews.name: University of Iowa
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: Minimum Ontario average on core academic subjects, including math/science/language/social science.
reviews.scenarioUse: Verified percentage component only; remaining academic/English/program requirements apply. Existing catalog already includes program evidence.

reviews.name: University of Northern Iowa
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: Cumulative academic subjects at secondary level; not Ontario Grade12top6.
reviews.scenarioUse: Verified percentage component only; remaining academic/English/program requirements apply. Existing catalog already includes program evidence.

reviews.name: Portland State University
reviews.verifiedAcademicRequirement: Strictly greater than70 overall average with OSSD, not greater-than-or-equal70.
reviews.scenarioUse: Verified percentage component only; remaining academic/English/program requirements apply. Existing catalog already includes program evidence.

notes: 12 schools reviewed: four full new catalog records, five additional GPA-review candidates, three reverified Ontario-specific candidates.
Toledo currently lists Sociology only as a minor; use History B.A. instead.
Youngstown Special Admission is discretionary and does not guarantee admission.
No official evidence found that 10 U.S. universities guarantee admission for every Ontario60–65/SAT1100 scenario. These new sources support a broader investigation list with explicit review status.
No Ontario GPA conversion may be borrowed from Texas State and applied to another university.
Arkansas State History threshold has unresolved page-scope discrepancy and should not be used as verified low-entry eligibility.
